title: SparrowLane API Portals
text:
SparrowLane API Portals

notes:
Lead: small platform team building embeddable AI chat widget for mid-market SaaS customers.
Primary ask: reliable hosted API for self-serve signups that won't break during marketing spikes.
Traffic profile: baseline 5-10 concurrent users, but marketing campaigns produce spikes: 300-600 concurrent for 10-20 minutes several times/month.
Concerns raised on call: frequent 429s from other vendors during bursts; client-side retry stacks doubling traffic; want guidance on concurrency limits + backoff best practices.
Prefer public cloud hosted API (fastest time-to-value). Cost sensitive - want recommendations for cheaper model fallback during heavy load.
Interested in features: streaming responses for chat, token-level cost reporting, per-route quotas, rate-limit headers and webhook for soft-throttling advice.
Quote from PO: 'We can't afford the widget to show 'Please try again' during product launches - need graceful degradation and clear retry guidance.'
Security: require SSO for dashboard + audit logs of API key usage; not asking for on-prem yet.
Internal: linked docs exist in Drive for pricing and playbook templates

technical_requirements:
SLOs: <300ms median generation for short chat messages; acceptable tail up to 1.2s during spikes if fallback is in place
Throughput target: sustained 50 qps for 90% of day; burst capacity up to 600 concurrent chat sessions for 10-20 minute windows
Tolerance: want <1% user-facing 5xx/429 across customer-facing flows
Expectations: clear rate-limit headers, quota status API, and example client-side backoff code (JS + Python)
Fallback plan: automatic routing to small/cheaper model variant during capacity strain; ability to reduce max_tokens or disable streaming gracefully

blockers:
unclear quota tiers for rapid bursts
need examples of graceful 429/backoff patterns
finance wants cost caps for self-serve before commit

poa_and_poc_plan:
Provision temporary hosted_api key for 14-day POC
SE to run synthetic load test simulating 600 concurrent sessions (10-20m bursts) and observe 429 behavior
Validate streaming + partial response behavior under soft-throttle
Deliver a short playbook (2 pages) for client-side retries, exponential backoff with jitter, and queueing guidance
If results acceptable: propose SMB monthly tier with burst credits + cost caps

next_step:
Schedule load-test POC with SE; provision temporary hosted_api key and sample traffic script

timeline:
2026-02-10 - Inbound signup, created sandbox account, submitted quick form (self-serve)
2026-02-12 - Discovery call with AE (Maya) + PO; high-level product fit confirmed
2026-02-14 - Deep-dive with SE (Jordan) focusing on rate limits, burst behavior; Fireflies: ff_2026-02-14_01
2026-02-15 - Sent SMB pricing deck + hosted_api FAQ (drive/redwood/sparrowlane-pricing-smb)
2026-02-18 - Requested POC; want load test and 429-handling demo before approving credits

commercial_notes:
Estimate: SMB starter ARR between $5k-$25k if POC shows stable handling of bursts
Finance ask: monthly cost cap feature or auto-shutdown thresholds for self-serve billing
Potential upsell: Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization to reduce token spend
